title: Trip around the city
text: Easy way to get to see all the highlights of the city you’re visiting. I’ve used the hop on hop off tour bus many times.
author: Robert_P

title: Great way to explore
text: Great way to explore & learn more about the area. The stops were conviently located and the wait between busses was minimal.
author: Valerie_M

title: Always rely on Viator
text: Reliable and easy place to buy tickets. I have used Viator many times and they give to full support if you have problems with booking.
author: Nidhi_G

title: Hop Hop off Bus tour.
text:
Absolutely superb sightseeing trip around Barcelona. 
Using the hop on hop off bus. We completed the orange and green route, we also had the catamaran trip. All of it was superb. 
Highly recommended.
author: garyttaylor

title: Hop on and off bus
text: Easy way to see city as you can get on and off to see the sights that interest you.  There are 2 buses that provide this so pay attention.
author: Doug_S

title: It can be cold and windy...
text: It can be cold and windy on the upper deck.  Be prepared. Bring a coat and hat.  Also, be sure to use the headphones.
author: Judith_H

title: Perfect for exploring Barcelona with a minimum of two days.
text: They hop on hop off bus is very convenient. Only if you are going to be staying in Barcelona tonight, plus. Otherwise, you will not have enough time to get the most of your hop on hop off excursion.
author: mariarG9251AN

title: Fun time on the bus
text: Always a great experience with the hop on and hop off tours bus . Gives you an overview of all the good spots then you can go back and check things out independently
author: Jacqueline_L

title: Staff was pleasant and I...
text:
Staff was pleasant and I enjoyed the narration. 

Regret that we didn’t do the green line due to the wait time of the boat ride.
author: Alicia_D

title: Round trip with breaks
text: It is worth buying a two-day ticket to see everything, one day for the orange route and the other for the green.
author: Andreas_P
